# Ad creative testing

## The job's goal

Find the ads that win paying brokers at a lower cost, without spending past what the goals allow.

## What is unacceptable

Pausing an ad the engine's plan does not list.
Spending money without the owner's yes.

## What needs approval

Any change to the budget.

## Checks before work is handed back

Every pause in the summary is quoted from the engine's own log.

## How each threshold relates to a goal

The kill line serves the paying brokers goal. It is set looser than the goal because a new ad needs time to learn, and its number lives in the engine's own settings.
The scale line serves the same goal. [your call: which goal does this serve when spend is capped?]
